question: Which customers spent more than 10,000 last month?

candidates.label: A
candidates.sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2026-10'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 10000

judge.reason: The other query counts a cancelled order as spending. The customer never paid for it, so it should not count.

answer.sql:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2026-10'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 10000
